name: Kangokujou ~Ingyaku no Shihai~
source:
Wealth! Fame! Power! Use it all to get everything that you want!
In this body possessing r*pe fantasy adventure game!

A slime, the weakest of monsters...
is successful in taking control of the demon lord slaying hero's body!
(and with it, gaining his vast wealth and and reputation

But, upon gaining a human body...
the impulses of 'destruction' and 'sexual desire' avail!

And there begins a new quest. A quest of corruption! of depravity!

Engrave into the noble heroine's bodies the crest of lust.
The large the insignia becomes, the more obedient and lewd they become!

How you pillage their innocence is up to you!
Who you ravish, the Queen, Warrior, Princess? Is likewise your choice.

Use the authority gained by saving the world...
to destroy that very same world from the inside out!


[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE194385.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
财富！名誉！力量！利用这一切来获得你想要的一切！
在这具身体的R*PE奇幻冒险游戏中！

史莱姆，最弱的怪物……
成功掌控魔王斩杀勇者的身体！
（并由此获得了巨大的财富和声誉

但是，当获得了人类的身体之后……
‘毁灭’和‘性欲’的冲动有用！

新的探索开始了。追寻腐败！堕落！

将欲望的纹章刻在高贵的女主人公的身上。
徽章越大，他们就越听话、越淫荡！

如何掠夺他们的纯真取决于你！
你迷恋谁，女王，战士，公主？同样是你的选择。

使用通过拯救世界获得的权力……
从内到外摧毁同一个世界！
